decisions.reason: Adding a subsection within Section 2 does not change the established top-level section sequence or permit section reordering.
The newly supplied Section 2 narrative subsection does not change the requirements for the budget sheet, proposal tables, or their replacements.
The Section 2 subsection is unrelated to the four biographies and their integration in the appendix.
Adding content to Section 2 does not alter the one-page letter, signature insertion, or displaced-photo handling requirements.
The added subsection might need to appear in the table of contents, but the evidence does not establish whether the table of contents lists subsections or only top-level sections.
The additional narrative subsection does not change the requirement to incorporate the organization chart into the final draft.
The added content may affect layout effort, but it does not change the existing page-limit target, compaction method, or compliance goal.
The new Section 2 text does not modify photo selection, inclusion, relocation, or Page 19 photo treatment.
The existing requirement already covers laying out and formatting the complete RFQ response; adding supplied narrative content does not change that layout requirement's state.

The message confirms use of Canva but does not change source ownership, editing access, asset restrictions, reuse rights, or signature insertion behavior; implementation status must not be propagated.
The supplied subsection does not establish any new hyperlink or alter the requirement that existing proposal hyperlinks remain functional.
The task-local addition of a Section 2 subsection does not change the deferred future template's modular section framework or lifecycle.
